voice.description: Voice name to use for text-to-speech

dbPath.description: Absolute path to the SQLite memory database; omit to use the default XDG data location

marketplace.description: Fetching abilities from the online marketplace

enabled.description: Use the online marketplace; false means Kaja never goes online for abilities

autoFetch.description: Pull the marketplace at startup when the last sync is over a day old

url.description: Git URL (or local path) of the repo whose marketplace/ folder `kaja abilities update` fetches (default: the Kaja repo)

ref.description: Branch or tag to fetch (default: main)

context.description: Keeping long conversations inside the model's context window

compact_at.description: How full the chat model's context may get (0.3-0.95) before older messages are summarised; `/compact` does it on demand

hosts.description: Where each stdio MCP ability runs, by name: "computer" or "sandbox"; the default follows the mode (local: computer, cloud: sandbox). Local "sandbox" needs a Kaja cloud sign-in; cloud "computer" has the terminal run it. shell = "computer" lets cloud chat use this shell

thinking.description: Show thinking indicator when the model is generating a response

toolDisplay.description: How tool calls show: minimal keeps one live row and a summary line in the chat, verbose lists every call, corner shows the current call in the header

codePreviewLines.description: Lines of a code block or approval command shown before it is cut short

voice.description: Read the assistant's replies aloud (needs a Speaches server, see [tts])

locale.description: Language for the chat and application

mode.description: Which backend `kaja` starts: the cloud API, or the local agent against your own provider

hotkeyModifier.description: Modifier key for the help/persona hotkeys; none works everywhere (alt types characters on some macOS terminals, ctrl collides with some host apps, meta needs the kitty keyboard protocol)

theme.description: Colour theme; auto picks dark or light by the terminal's background colour, terminal uses the terminal's own colour scheme

yolo.description: DANGEROUS developer flag: approve every shell command and tool call without asking, risky ones included (the hard guards still apply)
